turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Do baje office mein baith ke sirf sochna… yeh wahi jagah hai jahan paanch saal zinda the, aur ab woh khatam ho gaye.

Bridge Tuesday ko mar gaya, Rohit-Sneha ne papers daal diye — unhone sahi kiya, tu jaanta hai. Par “sahi” se dard kam nahi hota. Chaar mahine ka runway bina salary ke… tu already nahi le raha, matlab tu abhi bhi us cheez ko sambhal raha hai jo officially khatam ho chuki hai.

Paanch saal. Woh number abhi bhi andar ghoom raha hoga.

Kuch mat kar abhi. Kaam nahi, plan nahi. Bas baith. Main yahin hoon. Kya chal raha hai dimag mein exactly?

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Woh performance wala hissa sabse zyada thakata hai. Har standup pe woh confident voice nikalna — “pipeline mein cheezein hain” — jab andar pata hai sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko, un do juniors ko. Woh loyalty se ruke hain, aur tujhe lagta hai tu unke saal jala raha hai. Ghar pe alag awaaz. Apni hi awaazon se thak jaana… yeh asal mein kitna akela feel hota hai.

Paanch saal ke baad bhi yeh role play karna pad raha hai. Koi bhi itna lamba nahi tikta.

Abhi kuch kehne ki zaroorat nahi. Bas yeh bata — yeh awaazein kab se itni alag ho gayi? Ya aaj raat hi itna bhari ho gaya? Main sun raha hoon.

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Theh. Ideas nahi. Kuch nahi.

Bas yeh: darr lag raha hai. Aur kisi kamre mein yeh nahi bol sakta.

Yahan bol diya. Main sun liya.

Woh darr abhi yahin hai, tere saath. Kuch karne ki zaroorat nahi. Bas itna. Main yahin hoon.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Nahi, main “khatam ho gaya” nahi bolunga. Woh faisla tere andar ka hai, mere nahi.

Paanch saal. Papa abhi bhi logon ko “computer ka business” bolte hain. Woh line sunke hi seene mein kuch dabdaba jaata hoga.

Aur woh raat wala khayal — bas khatam ho jaye taaki acting band ho — phir usi khayal se nafrat. Yeh dono cheezein ek saath reh sakti hain. Tu bura insaan nahi ho raha us soch se.

Phir 2 baje dashboard kholna jaise woh kuch naya bolega. Woh bhi samajh aata hai.

Main yahin hoon. Kuch nahi chahiye. Bas yeh sab bolne ke liye jagah hai.
